## Verdict

**Lumen Path** costs least for a team of 30, at **$270 per month**. All three vendors' minimums (1, 10, 25) fall below the team size, so every vendor bills exactly 30 seats and the ranking follows the per-seat rate directly. Lumen Path's $9 rate is the lowest on the list.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Gable | $21 | 1 |
| Lumen Path | $9 | 10 |
| Estuary | $14 | 25 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 30 (team size) or the vendor minimum. No minimum binds at this headcount.

- **Gable:** minimum 1 < 30, so 30 seats paid. 30 × $21 = **$630 per month**.
- **Lumen Path:** minimum 10 < 30, so 30 seats paid. 30 × $9 = **$270 per month**.
- **Estuary:** minimum 25 < 30, so 30 seats paid. 30 × $14 = **$420 per month**.

Lumen Path is $150 per month cheaper than Estuary and $360 per month cheaper than Gable — $1,800 and $4,320 per year respectively. Effective rate equals list rate for all three: $9.00, $14.00 and $21.00 per person.

## Risks

- **Ranking is stable above 25 seats but not below.** Since no minimum binds at 30, cost scales linearly for all three. Lumen Path stays cheapest at any size at or above 25. Below 25, Estuary's $350 floor applies, and below 10, Lumen Path's $90 floor applies — at which point Gable's 1-seat minimum makes it cheaper for very small teams (4 seats or fewer).
- **Price only.** The list carries no feature, support, security or usage-limit detail. Gable charges 2.3× Lumen Path's rate; nothing in the source explains what, if anything, that buys.
- **No volume discounting documented.** At 30 seats, negotiated rates are common but unlisted; figures assume list price holds.
- **Monthly billing as stated.** Annual commitments, onboarding fees and switching costs are outside the source and could reorder these totals.
